learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected The Indian Ocean for Madrid and locked it in. Initial locked map instead displayed New York at 40.7 N,74 W.
observations.exploration: Madrid gave Spain 40.4 N,3.7 W to New Zealand 40.4 S,176.3 E. Beijing gave China 39.9 N,116.4 E to Argentina 39.9 S,63.6 W; Show me why unlocked. Initial unlocked New York counterpart was Ocean.
observations.reveal: Corrected answer New Zealand. Describes latitude north/south flip and 180-degree longitude shift; most land opposite ocean, only about 13% land-land, with US and China examples.
observations.visual: Inline screenshots inspected. Dot and blue ring clearly identify ends on equirectangular map; Beijing ring lies in southern South America. Initial New York selection mismatches Madrid prompt, but explicit instruction later resolves start.
observations.isolation: No-history preview present; 6/6 trust counter ignored.
references: CUA tab 543884107 snapshots and inline screenshots, no screenshot file saved.

prediction.reason: Concrete place question with plausible land/ocean alternatives.

interaction.reason: City changes visibly move both endpoints and preserve coordinate inversion.

payoff.reason: Explains numerical coordinate transformation and uncommon land-land result.
payoff.evidence: Madrid coordinates and 13% boundary in reveal.

clarity.reason: Controls legible but initial New York stage disagrees with Madrid prediction context.
clarity.evidence: Initial screenshot New York selected while question says Madrid.

transfer.reason: Reusable coordinate rule and examples offered, but no fresh post-rule application with applicability check.
transfer.evidence: Latitude flip, 180-degree longitude shift and US/China examples.

surprise.reason: Indian Ocean prediction overturned by New Zealand.

visualExplanation.evidence: Beijing screenshot and two city contrasts.

playfulness.reason: Presets and latitude/longitude controls invite exploration.

depth.evidence: Madrid and Beijing observations plus reveal.

whyCool: Switching from Madrid to Beijing moves the opposite ring from New Zealand to Argentina while preserving the latitude flip.
